title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Scenario Broadcast Crawl. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Scenario Broadcast Crawl
options.lineage: ORV Main Scenario channels and emergency broadcast crawls
options.thesis: The whole app is an on-air Scenario channel: Draft is a live option prompt; the fight is the crawl updating.
options.viewport: Home as channel guide; Lobby as greenroom with join requests on the crawl; Match as dual-seat on-air stage with Draft options as numbered broadcast choices.
options.risk: Broadcast chrome can feel like a news app unless Draft prompts and fight pulses stay game-first.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Sessions and Match state are flap rows; Draft options cascade letter-by-letter; fight updates clack down the board.
options.viewport: Lobby as the big board of seats and Match phase; Draft as flipping option rows; fight as cascading Life/Shield cells.
options.risk: Industrial transit grammar can wash out god-Boon identity.
options.case: Wins live dual-seat Operate clarity; weaker manhwa System identification than Scenario Crawl.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.thesis: Home, Lobby, and Match are overlapping system windows; Draft dialogs wear marching ants on the chosen Boon.
options.viewport: Desktop menu bar as app chrome; Match as a titled window; offers as nested dialogs; active seat selection in marching ants.
options.risk: Reads as Mac nostalgia before System apocalypse.
options.case: Wins Draft Operate clarity; fuses poorly because one-bit Mac grammar erases ORV/SL identification.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: Surreal letter-weather where grammar reshapes the ground
options.thesis: Boon names condense as storm-letters; the fight is grammar breaking into weather across the arena.
options.viewport: Home as a quiet page; Match as monumental grotesk matter; Draft words gather then lock; fight pulses letter-rain between seats.
options.case: Wins Omniscient Reader myth identification; fuses poorly for Operate cooldowns and dual-seat stats.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark auto-battler HUD with shop-row Draft and twin HP bars, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar TFT/Auto Chess chrome across Home, Lobby, and Match: offer row, loadout tray, centered fight readouts.
canonCard.risk: Readable and expected; erases Scenario/System identity as a look.
